body:
IGN: JapaneseSquid
Discord(ex. Name#1234): JapaneseSquid#7262
Timezone: EST/EDT
Why would you like to join the referee team(brief paragraph): I would like to help the community to make fair decisions  and deal with important matters to create a better playing experience. it is my interest in expanding my service to a more competitive level.
Best time of the week?: Weekends, and Fridays.
A paragraph or two to tell us something about you: I am 15 years old, A moderator on Avicus, and a friendly player who wants to help out as much as he can. I can speak English, Japanese, and limited Spanish. I would love to be a Referee to help out the players, once again, on a more competitive level.
Anything else?: Wow I'm early
